subject: Woodward AI procurement next steps — onboarding options and approver mapping
messages:
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Woodward AI — post-demo recap & procurement checklist

Hi Alice / Woodward team,

Thanks again for the demo today — appreciate the tight agenda and the clear priorities you shared. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment on procurement path and decision owners: 

What we covered
- Use case: inference for real-time content moderation (low-latency, predictable throughput)
- Target start: pilot with 50k tokens/day, 3-month evaluation window
- Constraints: SOC2 evidence + SAML/SSO for workspace, likely procurement through corporate purchasing or marketplace

Info we need from your side (asks)
1) Procurement route: do you prefer Marketplace (faster onboarding) or a PO/invoice route? If PO, do you have a template/sample we should expect?
2) Budget owner / approvers: who signs/approves? Please provide name, title, and email for the economic buyer, finance sponsor, and final signatory.
3) Timeline: expected procurement cycle (legal review, finance approval) and any blackout dates.

Attachments I included: mutual action plan (MAM) with two tracks (marketplace vs PO) and our marketplace onboarding checklist.

Proposed next steps
- If marketplace: we can start onboarding within 5 business days once you confirm accounts and funding method.
- If PO: please send your PO template and desired payment terms; we typically do Net30 for PO but can discuss Net45 for enterprise contracts.
- I'll loop in our pricing/ops lead (Ben) and procurement liaison (Monica) to own paperwork and timeline.

Can you confirm the budget owner(s) and whether Woodward has Marketplace purchasing enabled? If helpful, cc Thomas Liu (Finance) or forward to your procurement alias and I’ll adapt the MAM.

Thanks — I’ll follow up with Ben/Monica internally to prepare the marketplace checklist and a PO packet.

Best,
Chloe Martin
Senior AE | Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: woodward-mutual-action-plan.xlsx, redwood-marketplace-onboard-checklist.pdf

Hi Chloe — thanks for the clear recap. Quick answers from our side: 

1) Procurement route: We prefer Marketplace for speed (we already use a few NASA-marketplace vendors), but procurement/legal will need to confirm that the contract terms align with our data controls. If marketplace is blocked, PO is the fallback.

2) Budget & approvers: Economic buyer is Thomas Liu (Finance Lead) — thomas.liu@woodward.ai (cc'd on this reply). Final signatory for contracts is our Head of IT Ops, Maria Velez (maria.velez@woodward.ai). Finance sponsor (day-to-day) is Jenna Park (jenna.park@woodward.ai).

3) Timeline: If marketplace works, onboarding could be ~2 weeks. If PO required, expect 3–6 weeks depending on legal review.

Request: can you share a sample PO instruction page and a short SSO/SAML checklist so our security team can pre-screen? Also please confirm whether you offer a marketplace SKU for a pilot (smaller invoice footprint) vs full committed capacity.

Looping in Thomas and Jenna for visibility.

Thanks,
Alice
Head of Product Operations | Woodward AI
alice.chen@woodward.ai
